Overview on Main Aggregates releases:
Updated end 2026, 2027 and beginning of 2028 release planning
Please note that dates are PROVISIONAL until confirmed in Eurostat weekly release calendar
Eurostat’s current release pattern of European main GDP aggregates is the following:

Table 1: Release calendar
